verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships AI features (AI code reviewer, Rovo, AI-powered workflows), so a buyer can fairly ask whether their code can be kept out of AI model training. The axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a training opt-out or a no-training commitment. SOC2/ISO/GDPR compliance, encryption, and 2FA/IP allowlisting are adjacent security controls and earn no credit toward this story.
